value.answer: Agent Plugins 1.0 is now available in VS Code, Copilot CLI, and the Copilot app, allowing you to build a plugin once and use it across all compatible agent clients. This open standard packages agent skills and MCP servers into one installable plugin that is governed independently of any single vendor.
